argv: Treat piped JSON as the authoritative GDDP NodePacket. Work only in the current worktree. Implement its goal within its constraints, create its required artifacts, run relevant checks, then stop. Never modify graph truth or runtime databases.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: decision.md names the write path (or manual action) that produced status=failed/queue_state=running for job_20260711T16542651, with evidence
every UPDATE to jobs.status in scripts/ also sets queue_state to the matching value (engine.py expiry included), or the redundancy is collapsed with a documented rationale
a check exists (test or baseline.sh probe) that fails when any jobs row has mismatched status/queue_state
the existing inconsistent row is corrected via a documented, reversible step (SQL in decision.md), not silent mutation
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q scripts passes with no regressions

constraints: do not change receipt semantics or the human review gate
schema changes to queue.db are out of scope; column semantics only
graph truth stays human-owned; this node produces evidence only
packet.goal: Produce a reviewable result for node job-state-consistency
packet.title: Make jobs.status and jobs.queue_state agree on every write path
packet.why:
baseline.sh reported "running=2" when only one job was truly running: the
failed canary attempt job_20260711T16542651 sits at status=failed,
queue_state=running. At least one live write path updates status without
queue_state (decision_loop/engine.py expiry sets status='expired' only), and
the origin of the inconsistent row is undiagnosed. Every operator-facing
count reads one column or the other, so any divergence makes the dashboard
lie. Small surface, real correctness stakes.
